description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter for managing and displaying a list of quick sharing permissions in an Android application. It includes view holder logic, branding application, and interaction handling for permission selection.

classes.name: QuickSharingPermissionsAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying and managing quick sharing permissions, with branding support.

classes.name: QuickSharingPermissionsAdapter.QuickSharingPermissionViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual permission items, handling data binding and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ViewHolder for a permission item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of permission items.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies a new branding color and refreshes the list.

methods.name: bindData
methods.description: Binds a QuickPermissionModel to the ViewHolder's views.
